name: human-link
description: Human Link — gestion RH : Node.js + MongoDB + React

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm --prefix server run setup

scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test && npm --prefix client run i18n:check && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
